notes.title: Check Out Rally Mechanic Simulator Prologue!
notes.content:
If you’ve been wondering what we’ve been up to, we have some big news. [b]Rally Mechanic Simulator Prologue is live on Steam!
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35097038/8529375916bbbdd9afc4e3653279683c0f83e56d.png[/img]

Maybe it doesn’t have motorcycles, but if you love speed and tinkering, the game has everything that you need. Some of the features it has include:
[list]
[*] 2 rallies, a tarmac and a gravel one,
[*] a timing clock that puts a challenging spin on the mechanical games’ formula,
[*] a car inspired by a 90s JDM rally legend,
[*] minigames that will make your gameplay more varied,
[*] and a test drive mode!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35097038/d04c4c8f9d0773d6229beee7470cbeda1432970f.gif[/img]

We think that Rally Mechanic Simulator is quite similar to Motorcycle Mechanic Simulator, yet inherently different and expanded. At the end of the day, it allows you to tinker with some cool machinery and experience a thrill - and isn’t this why we love all motorised vehicles? Head [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3002090/Rally_Mechanic_Simulator_Prologue/]HERE [/url]to get your free copy of the prologue and have fun!

Oh, one more thing - if you manage to have your lap time in the top 5 by next Friday (19th of July), you will get a free copy of the game once it releases!
